activity: Saved final graph QC only; no inference, accuracy rescoring, raw-MI reads, or raw hash scan
local_inputs: Saved final graphs and requested hubs are resolved from dream_provenance.json; they are not redistributed in this report

method.graph_reader: NetBID2::get.SJAracne.network; directed graph from source and target columns; no simplification
method.degree_population: All incident vertices, total degree (in plus out); requested zero-target hubs are not added as isolates
method.formula: lm(log10(pk) ~ log10(k)) with intercept; pk=degree_distribution[-1]+1/V; k=1..max(total degree); adjusted R2
method.zero_bins: Zero-degree bin excluded; unobserved positive integer degree bins receive 1/V
method.undefined: NA for empty graph, maximum total degree below 3, or nonfinite adjusted R2; finite negative values retained
method.median_targets: All requested hubs including zero-target hubs
method.adjacency_normalization: Expand each noncomment source row to directed source-target-MI edges; omit zero-target rows from edge graph only; temporary files removed
method.validation: Edges, active hubs, requested hubs and median targets equal all frozen source records
